title: Pull connected accounts into the second brain
phrases: pull my connected accounts into my second brain
add my email contacts to the knowledge graph
turn my recent messages into linked notes
put my payments by month into the brain
add my recent google drive documents to the brain
put the emails I sent through resend into my second brain
feed my connectors into my notes

safety.rule: Read only against every source: only search, list and GET calls through the modules the customer already connected, no sign-in of its own, no write API. Opt in per source, bounded by a date window and a cap. Messages that look like they carry a password, key or sign-in code are left out whole, and so are Drive files whose name or opening text looks like credentials. Drive notes hold file metadata plus a short excerpt of Google Docs only; sent-email notes count recipients and never name them. Notes are written only on this computer and carry their source so they can be tidied away again.
